subject.title: Gateway Dashboard chat buttons lose busy state after tab switch and can interrupt active runs

question: Should maintainers keep the open dashboard recovery PR as the canonical path for this issue, close it as superseded by current main's active-run recovery, or ask for a narrower replacement focused only on any remaining tab-switch gap?
rationale: The narrow button-state path appears covered in current source and the latest release, but the linked PR remains open, conflicting, proof-gated, and broader than this issue, so automation should not choose the issue/PR disposition alone.

options.title: Review linked PR disposition
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers decide whether the linked PR should be repaired, narrowed, replaced, or closed as superseded.

options.title: Close after live proof
options.body: If live Dashboard proof confirms current main fully covers tab-switch recovery, close this issue and then close or supersede the linked PR with that evidence.

options.title: Split broader restart scope
options.body: If restart notices or in-progress transcript recovery still matter, track them separately from this Stop/Queue button-state report.

recommendation.title: Review linked PR disposition
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers decide whether the linked PR should be repaired, narrowed, replaced, or closed as superseded.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev authored the merged Stop-after-reconnect recovery that most directly overlaps the current issue.
